originalTitle: Oura is acquiring medical AI chatbot startup Counsel Health

content: Oura announced its quarterly earnings today and said it agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, after adding the company’s AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. Counsel Health calls itself an “AI-native primary care company,” using the app to deliver AI-generated responses and insights based on users’ health data reported from their wearables that can then proceed to a conversation with one of its in-house physicians. Oura says it expects the deal to close before the end of the year. Oura CEO Tom Hale said in an interview with Bloomberg that the acquisition is part of a plan to connect wearables, clinical AI, and access to doctors based on insights from biometric data to answer questions or monitor ongoing conditions. Counsel Health’s AI chatbot can connect Oura users to a real doctor directly from the app and draw on users’ biometric data from their wearables in its answers to medical questions. The plan they describe in the press release is to focus on three areas, including preventative care, acute care for episodic health concerns, and specialty and chronic care for things like reproductive and cardiometabolic health. According to Bloomberg, Counsel Health’s CEO Muthu Alagappan says it’s also planning to expand its network of on-demand physicians, which is currently “made up of about 50 people.” Counsel’s 70 employees will join Oura as part of the deal, with Alagappan becoming Oura’s chief clinical AI officer. Oura says in its announcement that Counsel will also continue offering its medical AI platform outside of Oura’s user base through new and existing enterprise partners, including “health plans, health systems, consumer health organizations, and employers.”
chineseTitle: Oura 正在收购医疗 AI 聊天机器人初创公司 Counsel Health
chineseSummary: Oura 今天公布了季度收益，并表示在今年早些时候将 Counsel Health 的人工智能聊天机器人添加到其应用程序中后，该公司同意以 6.25 亿美元收购 Counsel Health。 Counsel Health 自称为“人工智能原生初级保健公司”，使用该应用程序根据用户报告的健康数据提供人工智能生成的响应和见解 [...]
chineseContent: Oura 今天公布了季度收益，并表示在今年早些时候将 Counsel Health 的人工智能聊天机器人添加到其应用程序中后，该公司同意以 6.25 亿美元收购 Counsel Health。 Counsel Health 自称是一家“人工智能原生初级保健公司”，利用该应用程序根据用户可穿戴设备报告的健康数据提供人工智能生成的响应和见解，然后可以与其中一位内部医生进行对话。 Oura 表示，预计该交易将在今年年底前完成。 Oura 首席执行官汤姆·黑尔 (Tom Hale) 在接受彭博社采访时表示，此次收购是一项计划的一部分，该计划旨在连接可穿戴设备、临床人工智能以及根据生物识别数据的见解与医生联系，以回答问题或监测当前状况。 Counsel Health 的人工智能聊天机器人可以直接从应用程序将 Oura 用户与真正的医生联系起来，并利用用户可穿戴设备中的生物识别数据来回答医疗问题。他们在新闻稿中描述的计划将重点关注三个领域，包括预防性护理、突发性健康问题的急性护理以及生殖和心脏代谢健康等方面的专业和慢性护理。据彭博社报道，Counsel Health 首席执行官 Muthu Alagappan 表示，该公司还计划扩大其按需医生网络，目前“由约 50 人组成”。作为交易的一部分，Counsel 的 70 名员工将加入 Oura，Alagappan 将成为 Oura 的首席临床人工智能官。 Oura 在公告中表示，Counsel 还将继续通过新的和现有的企业合作伙伴（包括“健康计划、卫生系统、消费者健康组织和雇主”）在 Oura 用户群之外提供其医疗人工智能平台。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
